wb9_war.topic: Deaths and Operation Iron Wall since Oct 2023

claims.text: OHCHR: 7 Oct 2023–17 Oct 2025, 1,001 Palestinians killed in the West Bank incl. East Jerusalem, 213 children; 968 by Israeli forces, 33 by settlers (alone or with soldiers); 59 Israelis (incl. 22 security personnel) killed by Palestinians in the West Bank and Israel in the same period. 1,001 = 43% of WB Palestinian deaths in 20 years; OHCHR found 449 of those killed by forces unarmed and not involved in violence; 108 airstrikes; few investigations.

Iron Wall began 21 Jan 2025 in Jenin, extended to Tulkarm 27 Jan; IDF aims: degrade militant infrastructure, remove threats; PA had fought Jenin Brigades from Dec 2024; tanks entered Jenin 23 Feb 2025, first since 2002; Katz said troops would stay; IDF reported 102 militants killed; operation ongoing 2026.

OHCHR report Sept 2026: more than 33,000 displaced from Jenin, Nur Shams, Tulkarm camps in Jan–Feb 2025; still unable to return July 2026 (UNRWA 33,362); by Oct 2025 52% of structures in Jenin camp, 48% Nur Shams, 36% Tulkarm destroyed or damaged; OHCHR said it may amount to forcible transfer, a crime against humanity; Israel describes Iron Wall as counter-terrorism against armed groups.

wb9_annex.topic: Settlement approvals, E1, annexation votes, Smotrich powers, US sanctions

claims.text: Peace Now/Kerem Navot: 27,941 settlement housing units advanced in 2025, more than double the prior record (2023); 40,064 in 2023–25; 102 new settlements approved by cabinet since Dec 2022 (9 Feb 2023, 5 Jun 2024, 13 Mar 2025, 22 May 2025, 19 Dec 2025, 34 Mar 2026); new outposts 33 (2023), 61 (2024), 91 (2025); 25,959 dunams declared state land 2023–25; ~824,000 dunams in all (~14.5% of WB).

Coalition agreement 1 Dec 2022 created a Settlements Administration under Smotrich in the Defense Ministry; June 18 2023 cabinet moved planning approvals to Smotrich; Civil Administration powers moved to a civilian deputy; Disengagement Law repealed for northern WB 21 Mar 2023; land registration opened May 2025; Feb 8 2026 cabinet transferred some PA demolition powers in Areas A and B and changed land-purchase rules.

E1: 3,401 units near Ma'ale Adumim given final approval Aug 2025; Smotrich said it would 'permanently bury the idea of a Palestinian state' and 'they will talk about a Palestinian dream, and we will continue to build a Jewish reality'; presented as response to UK/France/Canada recognition plans; E1 links Jerusalem to Ma'ale Adumim and divides the West Bank.
23 Jul 2025 Knesset passed 71–13 a non-binding motion calling to apply sovereignty to Judea, Samaria and the Jordan Valley, declaring the West Bank 'an inseparable part of the Land of Israel'.

22 Oct 2025 bill to apply sovereignty to all settlements passed preliminary reading 25–24 during Vance's visit, opposed by Netanyahu's office as an opposition 'provocation'; Vance called it 'very stupid'; Trump: 'It won't happen... I gave my word to the Arab countries', Israel 'would lose all of its support from the United States'.

EO 14115 signed 1 Feb 2024 created sanctions for those undermining peace in the West Bank; four settlers designated first; Trump revoked it 20 Jan 2025; OFAC on 24 Jan 2025 delisted 18 individuals and 17 entities including Amana, Hilltop Youth, Lehava, Tzav 9 and also the Palestinian Lions' Den.
